Class H3MapInteractionHandler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.H3MapInteractionHandler
public class H3MapInteractionHandler extends Object
Handles user input interactions, mouse picking, zoom/pan navigation, and tooltip tracking for H3MapCanvas.

De-couples mouse event lifecycle from canvas graphics rendering:

  • Orthographic 3D Raycasting: Inverts screen $(x, y)$ pixels to spherical geodetic $(\phi, \lambda)$ coordinates via 3D Euler rotation matrices: \[ dx = \frac{x - x_c}{R}, \quad dy = \frac{y_c - y}{R}, \quad z_r = \sqrt{1 - (dx^2 + dy^2)} \]
  • Equirectangular 2D Inversion: Linear affine transformation from canvas viewport to geographic bounds: \[ \lambda = \frac{x - \text{offsetX}}{S} + \lambda_{\min}, \quad \phi = \phi_{\max} - \frac{y - \text{offsetY}}{S} \]
  • Hexagonal Cell Resolution: Nearest neighbor spatial lookup accelerated by H3Service.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
